newsitem.title: CHINA: China teacher hacks three students to death.
newsitem.headline: China teacher hacks three students to death.

text.p: A disgruntled teacher in northwestern China has been arrested for hacking three of his students to death with an axe, the Yangcheng Evening News said in an edition seen in Beijing on Friday.

Zhang Xinde, 34, was "resentful" because he was demoted and sent to teach at Ganjiagou elementary school in Cheng'guan county in Gansu province. He had previously served as principal of another elementary school, the newspaper said.
On September 16, Zhang gave 18 of his fifth-grade students sleeping pills, telling them they were taking medication to help improve their memories, it said.
He then hacked three of the students to death with an axe as they slept, the newspaper said.
Police arrested Zhang shortly after the murders. The other 15 students were revived after receiving emergency treatment.
The newspaper did not explain the delay in reporting the incident.
